name: nexushire
description: NexusHire — an AI-powered job portal with an explainable candidate/role matching engine.

scripts.smoke: vite build --ssr smoke/ssr-entry.tsx --outDir smoke-dist --logLevel warn && node smoke/run.mjs
scripts.test:resume: vite build --ssr smoke/resume-entry.ts --outDir smoke-dist-resume --logLevel warn && node smoke-dist-resume/resume-entry.js
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run test:resume
